title: Cell Type Annotation Collection
description: A collection of cell type annotations sourced from a published atlas dataset.

AtlasPaper.description: The atlas publication from which annotations are derived.

local_text_path.description: Path (repo-relative or absolute) to a local full-text file for the primary atlas paper, used when ASTA/EuropePMC cannot reach it.

subatlas_papers.description: Upstream studies that contributed cell types to this atlas. Shape mirrors subatlas_resolver.discover() output; entries progress through statuses as they are resolved.

SubatlasPaper.description: A contributing upstream study (subatlas) referenced by this atlas.

label.description: Raw contributing-study label as written in label_provenance.json.

first_author.description: First author surname parsed from the label, if any.

year.description: Publication year parsed from the label, if any.

venue.description: Journal/venue parsed from the label, if any.

total_cells.description: Number of cells this study contributed, if known.

doi.description: Resolved DOI of the contributing study. Empty string until resolved.

proposed_doi.description: Best-guess DOI from the top Semantic Scholar candidate, pending confirmation.

proposed.description: Candidate matches from Semantic Scholar search.

SubatlasCandidate.description: A Semantic Scholar candidate match for a contributing study.

DataProvenance.description: Where the annotations in this file came from.

dataset_id.description: External dataset identifier (e.g. CELLxGENE dataset id).

source_url.description: URL the data was fetched from.

file_path.description: Local path the data was read from.

obs_column.description: obs/ column used as the cell-type label.

n_cells_total.description: Total cells in the source dataset.

CellTypeAnnotation.description: One cell-type annotation. Reserved fields are named below; every other key is a diverse co-annotation (covariate) that must conform to the Covariate shape. Covariate KEYS vary per atlas, so they are not enumerated; only their VALUE shape is constrained.

label.description: Cell type annotation label, preserved verbatim from the source.

scope.description: Biological context/origin, preserved as author text (e.g. 'embryonic', 'fetal', 'adult'). Free text by design — NOT an enum; controlled vocabulary belongs on a mapped field, not on this raw value.

granularity.description: Resolution of the annotation, preserved as author text. Free text by design — NOT an enum.

n_cells.description: Number of cells carrying this label in the source dataset.

Covariate.description: A co-annotation value: either a scalar (e.g. germlayer='ECTODERM') or a distribution over values (e.g. organ, development_stage). Author values are preserved verbatim; ontology mapping is additive (see CovariateValue).

CovariateValue.description: One value in a co-annotation distribution. 'value' is the verbatim author text and MAY itself already be an ontology CURIE; 'curie'/'label'/'ontology' are filled when the value is, or has been mapped to, an ontology term.

value.description: Verbatim author value. May already be a CURIE (e.g. 'HsapDv:0000048').

share.description: Fraction of cells with this value (0..1).

curie.description: Ontology term the value is/maps to, e.g. 'HsapDv:0000048'.

label.description: Human-readable label for the mapped ontology term.
